Jello Cool Whip Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 12:04am

Ingredients




1 (6 oz.) box cherry or strawberry 1 cup crushed pineapple, drained
8 ounces Cool Whip
1 cup miniature marshmallows
1 cup chopped nuts (optional)

Preparation

1 Prepare Jello as usual until firm. Mix Jello with beater until foamy. Add pineapple and Cool Whip and nuts and mix well. Fold in marshmallows and chill. Top with more Cool Whip if desired when ready to serve.
